text: “I shall only hear of that happiness. I am going away again; Lucy has not told you, perhaps?” “Then the future will never join on to the past again, Maggie? That book is quite closed?” The gray eyes that had so often looked up at her with entreating worship, looked up at her now, with a last struggling ray of hope in them, and Maggie met them with her large sincere gaze. “That book never will be closed, Philip,” she said, with grave sadness; “I desire no future that will break the ties of the past. But the tie to my brother is one of the strongest.
